relevance_note: Cohort of Danon disease patients with individual data: 'This study reports on seven patients of three different families with Danon disease.'
method_note: Read by hand; a Python script in scratch assembled the JSON and sliced Table 3 row spans (patients are columns; header row 'Patient number, sex' with values '1, m' ... '7, f'); script output checked against the table. Labels: 'Patient 1', 'Patient 2', 'Patient 5' are used in the text/Figure 4 legend; patients 3, 4, 6, 7 have only the Table 3 number, so 'Table 3 #n'. Table 3 'Age (years)' recorded as age at last evaluation. Table 1/2 give only group means (not used per person; CK not assignable). Family assignment not reported per patient (Family 1: LAMP-2 splice acceptor 'IVS5, 2A-G'; Families 2 and 3 western blot only). Patients 1 and 2 are cousins with 'the same mutation in LAMP2' (Figure 4 + Discussion); variant rows kept with 'not reported' because the paper never says these cousins are Family 1. Intro variant 'IVS5,G-A, +1; OMIM: 309060.0005' is background, no person. Linked by uniquely printed values: Patient 2 = first-degree AV block (PR 264 ms = Table 3 col 2 PQ), and = flutter/CTI ablation/stroke/heart failure patient (Complications 'Stroke, Heart Tx' only in col 2). Group statements naming 'all male patients', 'female patients', 'no patient', 'all but one patient' (Patient 5 named) applied as group rows. EP study (accessory pathway, HV interval) applied to males only: 'All male patients underwent electrophysiological investigation' and HV is n/a for females, though text says 'all patients'. Checklist ventricular pre-excitation left not reported for the 7 patients: ECG shows short PR/slurred 'delta wave' mimicking pre-excitation, but accessory pathway excluded by EP study in males; females have QRS slurring but no PR <120 ms. 'Ventricular hypertrophy' (all males) not mapped to LVH checklist for #3/#4 (broader). 'Yes'/'No' cells read as explicit words. Literature persons included: ref 11 (14-year-old male) and ref 1 two boys (sex + features); counts-only summaries of refs 6, 13, 14, 15 excluded. Contradictions: Results says the cousin of the IVS 46 mm patient had IVS 18 mm/dilative phenotype (= Table 3 col 4), but Figure 4/Discussion make Patient 2 (IVS 15) the cousin; not assigned. Figure 4 says Patient 1 posterior wall 46 mm vs Table 3 PW 45/IVS 46. Discussion says 75% of males had AF vs table/text 2 of 4. Intro 'IVS5,G-A, +1' vs Methods 'IVS5, 2A-G'. Abstract: accessory pathway excluded by EP study 'in all patients' though EP only in males.
